summary: Emits a driver-table audio event (message ID 77) when a teammate-related session condition holds. Guards on dword_7D0308 (race-active flag) being non-zero, flt_7CF3C8 (track/condition state) being non-zero, and the team/constructor field at +0x4894 of the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8) matching the same field of the AI entrant a1. When all pass, DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion fills a local 8-float struct with message ID 77 and sentinel defaults, then InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v1) inserts it into the shared driver table. Called by sub_49B9A0.

local_names.a1: AI entrant/vehicle pointer whose +0x4894 team field is compared against the player vehicle
local_names.v1: local driver-data/time struct filled by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion before insertion

operations.description: If dword_7D0308 (race-active flag) is zero, return without emitting the event.
If flt_7CF3C8 (track/condition state) is 0.0, return without emitting the event.
If the player vehicle's team/constructor field at dword_7C54E8 + 0x4894 differs from the AI entrant's a1 + 0x4894, return (entrant is not a teammate).
DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v1, 77, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) fills the local driver-data/time struct v1 with message ID 77 and sentinel default indices/floats.
InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v1) inserts the populated entry into the shared driver table.
Void function; returns after emitting the event or when any guard fails. Called by sub_49B9A0.
